presets.manager: All finite module permissions; never grants owner/local operations or access management
presets.custom: Explicit finite permissions; reject unknown application/module/action

endpoints.GET /me: Verified Clerk JWT, all signed users including pending; returns AccessView, no application data
endpoints.GET /catalog: Owner only; returns this application/module catalog, role presets and directoryConfigured
endpoints.GET /users?offset=0&limit=20&q=: Owner only; paginated local registration/access list
endpoints.POST /users/sync: Owner only; synchronizes registered users from Clerk Backend API, never overwrites grants
endpoints.PUT /users/{subject}: Owner only; optimistic version required; owner row immutable; audited update

accessViewShape.subject: user_...
accessViewShape.displayName: Display label from verified directory or subject
accessViewShape.configuredApplications: Stored per-app role and permissions; owner editors use this while effective grants are empty for pending/suspended

behavior.newUser: pending with no permissions; cryptographic JWT auth only for /me
behavior.owner: Configured exact subject only, active with finite full permissions; no first-user/email/org-role fallback
behavior.revocation: Fetch authoritative access on each API request, per-request reuse only, no stale-token role fallback
behavior.authorityFailure: 503 fail closed; never fallback to JWT org/admin or legacy allowlist
behavior.peerIntegrations: Keep separately authenticated service peer routes; never accept user-supplied peer headers as user grants
behavior.rowOwnership: Keep existing draft/project membership and ownership constraints; a module grant alone does not replace them
behavior.unknownRoutes: Owner only until explicitly mapped; frontend hiding does not grant API access
